integrations.name: Discord
integrations.description: Everything your bot does in Discord.

integrations.name: ER:LC
integrations.description: Read the status of your Emergency Response: Liberty County private server and run commands in it.
integrations.data_shared: Its blocks send ER:LC your server key and the commands you run. To run commands, authorize Kite for your server once after enabling it.

integrations.name: Popcat
integrations.description: Jokes, facts, text effects, lookups like the weather or a GitHub user, and meme and welcome card images.
integrations.data_shared: Its blocks send Popcat the text and image URLs you enter in them. Images are made by Popcat when Discord loads them.
